procedure: 把關鍵數據與本課算例逐項對照，標出哪些是公開工程數據、哪些是教學假設。
沿著工程時間軸，標出設計、施工、事件與維護改造的關鍵決策點，說明每個決策改變了哪一條系統路徑或檢核。

從代表工程中選一個與本課比較，列出埋深或斷面、地質水文、支護系統與施工方法的差異。
procedureEn: Compare the key figures with this course's worked example and mark which are public project data and which are teaching assumptions.
Along the timeline, mark the key design, construction, event and retrofit decisions and say which system path or check each one changed.
Against the listed codes and standards, find the kind of clause behind this course's tests or acceptance steps, noting edition and jurisdiction.
Pick one landmark project to compare with this course and list differences in depth or section, ground and groundwater, support system and construction method.

guides.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

guides.title: 機制、算例與驗證：砂井與垂直排水板
guides.titleEn: Mechanisms, calculations and verification: Sand drains and prefabricated vertical drains
guides.concept: 砂井與預製排水板縮短軟土排水路徑，使超額孔壓較快消散，但不會直接消除土的可壓縮性。本課以網格幾何、等效直徑、水平壓密時間與安裝塗抹為主線，連結井阻、載重、沉陷及排水老化，建立以孔壓與變形共同判斷的卸載交接條件。
guides.conceptEn: Sand drains and prefabricated drains shorten drainage paths and accelerate excess-pressure dissipation without eliminating compressibility. The course connects grid geometry, equivalent diameter, radial time and installation smear to well resistance, loading, settlement and drain deterioration, establishing unloading and handover criteria from both pressure and movement.
procedure: 排水路徑縮短會加快壓力擴散，理想擴散時間隨特徵長度平方變化，這是垂直排水構想的基礎。實際排水板網格同時改變影響半徑、井徑比與塗抹比例，不能只用長度平方比直接預測現場工期；土層排水方向也需要辨識。本比值特別保持無因次參數不變，並非排水板間距改變後的工期比；實際n、塗抹與井阻會一同變動。
排水板網格把土體分成單井影響單元，等效圓面積用於徑向壓密分析。三角形與方形排列有不同的面積換算，施工偏位及漏插又會形成較大未排水區；名目間距需要與實際安裝位置一起驗證。係數一點零五是等面積近似，不描述邊界單元或排水不均；異常網格應以實際幾何重新建立模型。
排水板是帶狀而非圓管，徑向土體分析常以等效圓直徑表示其周長效果。寬度與厚度之外，濾布透水性、芯材通道及受壓後變形都影響排水，幾何等效不等於水力容量等效，也不能直接套用砂井直徑。等周長式屬模型近似，不是流道內徑；受壓排水能力及土體濾層相容性需要獨立的水力試驗。
徑向壓密的時間因子把水平壓密係數、時間及單井影響尺寸結合，便於比較不同觀測時段。它本身不是壓密完成度，還需井徑比、塗抹與井阻的函數；水平係數也不能無條件用垂直壓密試驗值替代。本算例明確使用平方公尺每一天，時間亦以天計；要從Tr求壓密度，還必須指定所採理論及全部無因次參數。
插設套管擾動排水板周圍土體，可能重塑黏土並形成低水平滲透性的塗抹區。排水路徑雖變短，水仍需穿越這個局部阻力；因此增加排水板數量不一定按理想比例加速壓密，工具尺寸與土體敏感性需共同考慮。滲透比不足以完整描述塗抹效應，還需要塗抹區尺寸與原土各向異性；不能把本比值當普遍材料常數。
水進入排水板後還必須沿芯材向排水層流動，長排水板、圍壓及彎折可能造成顯著井阻。把排水板當成零水頭損失邊界會高估深部排水，砂墊層及出口不暢也可能限制整個系統，需分辨土內阻力與排水通道阻力。這是指定工況的等效阻力而非材料常數，與長度、圍壓及流量條件有關；井阻模型需保留實際排水方向。
預壓荷載初期可主要轉成超額孔壓，隨排水消散，更多荷載才移交給土骨架並引起壓密。若只量測地表荷重而沒有孔壓，就不能判定有效應力增加多少；水位變化與不同土層的初始壓力也需用同一基準處理。增量式需同一位置與時刻且正負號一致，不能把絕對孔壓混入超額孔壓；總應力分布還受荷載擴散影響。
正常壓密黏土在一維條件下可用壓縮指數與有效應力對數關係估算沉陷，排水板主要改變到達此沉陷的速度而非終值。若存在先期壓密、不同應力路徑或次壓密，需分段採用相應參數，不能把一條正常壓密線套用所有土層。此式明定正常壓密、一維及以十為底對數，未含側移；Cc為無因次斜率，不能與以自然對數定義的參數混用。
排水板隨土體沉陷彎折、圍壓增加或濾布堵塞，通水能力可能下降，因此出廠直條試驗不足以代表全工期。衰減比例應在相同水力坡降與圍壓下比較，才能辨別材料性能改變；現場出水下降也可能單純因超額孔壓已減少。百分比只對相同試驗邊界成立，不能把不同水頭下的流量直接比較；通水衰減也不等於壓密速度同比下降。
由實測沉陷除以估計最終主要壓密沉陷，可得到沉陷定義的平均壓密度，但分母本身有模型不確定度。地表沉陷可能混入側移或次壓密，孔壓定義的完成度也未必一致；卸載必須用多種證據確認剩餘變形符合資產需求。此壓密度以可靠的主要壓密終值為前提，不是通用卸載門檻；若終值重估，比例及殘餘沉陷都必須一起更新。
procedureEn: Shorter drainage paths accelerate pressure diffusion, whose ideal characteristic time varies with squared length. This motivates vertical drains, but actual spacing changes influence radius, drain-size ratio and smear proportion together. A length-squared ratio alone therefore cannot predict field schedule, and relevant drainage directions must also be identified. This ratio explicitly holds dimensionless parameters fixed and is not the schedule ratio after changing drain spacing; actual size ratio, smear and well resistance change together.

A drain grid divides soil into influence cells, represented by equivalent circular area in radial analysis. Triangular and square layouts use different area conversions, while misplaced or omitted drains create larger undrained zones. Nominal spacing therefore requires verification against actual installation positions rather than reliance on the layout drawing alone. The coefficient is an equal-area approximation, not a model of boundary cells or uneven drainage; irregular grids require revised geometry.

Band drains are not circular pipes, so radial soil analysis commonly uses an equivalent diameter related to perimeter. Width and thickness do not capture filter permeability, core channels or compression. Geometric equivalence therefore is not hydraulic-capacity equivalence and cannot be substituted directly for a sand-drain diameter. The perimeter relation is a modelling approximation, not internal channel diameter; confined discharge and soil-filter compatibility need separate hydraulic tests.

The radial time factor combines horizontal consolidation coefficient, time and cell size to compare observation periods. It is not itself degree of consolidation, which also depends on drain-size ratio, smear and well resistance. Horizontal coefficients cannot automatically be replaced by vertical-test values without justification of anisotropy. This example explicitly uses square metres per day and time in days; converting Tr to consolidation degree still requires the selected theory and all dimensionless parameters.

Installation mandrels disturb surrounding soil, potentially remoulding clay into a zone of lower horizontal permeability. Although the drainage path shortens, water must still cross this local resistance. More drains therefore need not accelerate consolidation by the ideal proportion, and tool size and soil sensitivity must be considered together. Permeability ratio alone does not define smear; its extent and native-soil anisotropy are also needed, and this ratio is not universal.

After entering the drain, water travels along the core to an outlet. Long drains, confinement and bending can create significant well resistance. Assuming zero drain head loss overestimates deep drainage, while a restricted blanket or outlet can govern the whole system. Distinguish soil resistance from resistance inside the drainage path. This is equivalent resistance for one condition, not a material constant; length, confinement and flow matter, and the well-resistance model must retain the actual drainage direction.

Surcharge may initially appear mainly as excess pore pressure; drainage progressively transfers more load to the skeleton and causes consolidation. Applied surface load alone cannot establish effective-stress gain without pressure observations. Groundwater changes and layer-specific initial pressures also require one consistent reference. The increment relation requires the same location, time and sign convention; absolute and excess pressures are not interchangeable, and total stress also reflects load spread.

For normally consolidated clay in one-dimensional conditions, compression index and logarithmic effective stress estimate settlement. Drains mainly change how quickly settlement occurs rather than its ultimate value. Preconsolidation, different stress paths and secondary compression require appropriate segments and parameters instead of one virgin-compression line for every layer. The formula specifies normally consolidated one-dimensional behaviour and base-ten logarithms, excluding lateral movement; dimensionless Cc cannot be mixed with a natural-log parameter.

Drain bending during settlement, rising confinement and filter clogging can reduce discharge, so a straight factory test does not represent the whole project. Compare deterioration at consistent gradient and confinement to identify material change. Falling field discharge may instead reflect reduced excess pressure and must not automatically be called clogging. The percentage requires identical test boundaries; flow at different heads is not directly comparable, and capacity loss does not imply proportional slowing of consolidation.

Measured settlement divided by estimated ultimate primary settlement gives a settlement-based average consolidation degree, but its denominator is uncertain. Surface settlement may include lateral movement or secondary compression, and a pressure-based degree need not match exactly. Unloading therefore requires multiple evidence streams that confirm tolerable residual movement. This degree assumes a reliable ultimate primary settlement and is not a universal unloading threshold; revised ultimate estimates require updating both the ratio and residual settlement.
evidence: 設計者應分開記錄尺度示意與實際徑向壓密模型；卸載須依觀測而非單一平方比例放行。本比值特別保持無因次參數不變，並非排水板間距改變後的工期比；實際n、塗抹與井阻會一同變動。
竣工網格須保留實際位置與未完成深度；地工設計者核定補插及監測點代表性後才驗收。係數一點零五是等面積近似，不描述邊界單元或排水不均；異常網格應以實際幾何重新建立模型。
材料驗收應核對受壓、彎折及濾布試驗條件；設計者確認與實際土壓及沉陷相符後才採用。等周長式屬模型近似，不是流道內徑；受壓排水能力及土體濾層相容性需要獨立的水力試驗。
計算書須標示ch的試驗方向、單位與應力範圍；地工設計者核准完整壓密函數後再作排程推估。本算例明確使用平方公尺每一天，時間亦以天計；要從Tr求壓密度，還必須指定所採理論及全部無因次參數。
安裝設備與套管尺寸變更需重審塗抹假設；地工設計者以試驗區反應核定實際設計參數。滲透比不足以完整描述塗抹效應，還需要塗抹區尺寸與原土各向異性；不能把本比值當普遍材料常數。
evidenceEn: The designer separates scaling illustration from actual radial-consolidation modelling; unloading follows observations rather than one squared ratio. This ratio explicitly holds dimensionless parameters fixed and is not the schedule ratio after changing drain spacing; actual size ratio, smear and well resistance change together.

As-built grids retain actual positions and incomplete depths; the geotechnical designer approves additional drains and monitoring representativeness before acceptance. The coefficient is an equal-area approximation, not a model of boundary cells or uneven drainage; irregular grids require revised geometry.

Acceptance checks confinement, bending and filter test conditions; the designer confirms their relevance to actual earth pressure and settlement before use. The perimeter relation is a modelling approximation, not internal channel diameter; confined discharge and soil-filter compatibility need separate hydraulic tests.

State ch direction, units and stress range; the geotechnical designer approves the full consolidation function before schedule estimation. This example explicitly uses square metres per day and time in days; converting Tr to consolidation degree still requires the selected theory and all dimensionless parameters.

Changing installation equipment or mandrel size requires review of smear assumptions; the geotechnical designer approves parameters using trial-area response. Permeability ratio alone does not define smear; its extent and native-soil anisotropy are also needed, and this ratio is not universal.
pitfalls: 把理想百分之四時間當實際排程，會提前卸除預壓，留下未消散孔壓與後續沉陷。本比值特別保持無因次參數不變，並非排水板間距改變後的工期比；實際n、塗抹與井阻會一同變動。
只按等效直徑選材可能忽略芯材壓潰或濾布堵塞，實際井阻遠大於設計假設。等周長式屬模型近似，不是流道內徑；受壓排水能力及土體濾層相容性需要獨立的水力試驗。
忽略塗抹會高估排水速率，試驗區尚未達預期便需重新解釋模型，而非只增加預壓荷重。滲透比不足以完整描述塗抹效應，還需要塗抹區尺寸與原土各向異性；不能把本比值當普遍材料常數。
把預壓全重當成已完成有效應力，會高估土體強度及壓密度，卸載後留下可觀後續沉陷。增量式需同一位置與時刻且正負號一致，不能把絕對孔壓混入超額孔壓；總應力分布還受荷載擴散影響。
忽略彎折與堵塞會讓深部排水變慢，若只按初始材料性能安排卸載，就可能留下殘餘孔壓。百分比只對相同試驗邊界成立，不能把不同水頭下的流量直接比較；通水衰減也不等於壓密速度同比下降。
pitfallsEn: Using the ideal four-percent time as a schedule can release surcharge early, leaving excess pressure and later settlement. This ratio explicitly holds dimensionless parameters fixed and is not the schedule ratio after changing drain spacing; actual size ratio, smear and well resistance change together.

Selecting by equivalent diameter alone can miss crushed cores or clogged filters, producing much greater well resistance than assumed. The perimeter relation is a modelling approximation, not internal channel diameter; confined discharge and soil-filter compatibility need separate hydraulic tests.

Ignoring smear overpredicts drainage rate; underperforming trials require model reassessment rather than merely adding surcharge. Permeability ratio alone does not define smear; its extent and native-soil anisotropy are also needed, and this ratio is not universal.

Treating all surcharge as mobilized effective stress overstates strength and consolidation and can leave substantial later settlement after unloading. The increment relation requires the same location, time and sign convention; absolute and excess pressures are not interchangeable, and total stress also reflects load spread.

Ignoring bending and clogging slows deep drainage; unloading based only on initial material performance can leave residual pressure. The percentage requires identical test boundaries; flow at different heads is not directly comparable, and capacity loss does not imply proportional slowing of consolidation.

guides.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
guides.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

related.title: 地盤壓密灌漿
related.transfer: 可遷移「排水距離尺度的機理與驗證」與「有效應力成長的機理與驗證」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；地盤壓密灌漿的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Drainage-length scale mechanism and verification" and "Effective-stress gain mechanism and verification" transfer, while ground conditions, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Compaction grouting must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦徑向排水、塗抹效應與壓密完成度；地盤壓密灌漿則以低流動性灌漿的擠密、孔壓與資產反應為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on radial drainage, smear effects and consolidation completion; Compaction grouting centres on low-mobility grout displacement, pore pressure and asset response, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「排水距離尺度」與「不排水孔壓」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到地盤壓密灌漿，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「填空與擠密分辨的機理與驗證」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Drainage-length scale” and “Undrained pore pressure”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Compaction grouting, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Void filling versus densification mechanism and verification", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.title: 砂井與垂直排水板
history.titleEn: Sand drains and prefabricated vertical drains
history.text: 砂井與預製排水板縮短軟土排水路徑，使超額孔壓較快消散，但不會直接消除土的可壓縮性。本課以網格幾何、等效直徑、水平壓密時間與安裝塗抹為主線，連結井阻、載重、沉陷及排水老化，建立以孔壓與變形共同判斷的卸載交接條件。公開資料沿革以指南出版及資料覆核為準，不冒充個別工程施工史。2017年：美國聯邦公路管理局地盤改良頁列入兩冊地盤改良參考手冊；2017年：香港地盤勘察指南二提供二〇一七年更新版本，作為調查證據背景。比較案例僅說明工程用途與界面差異，未核對的工法不作實績聲稱。本課重建公開原理及原創教學算例，不代表任何專案設計文件。
history.textEn: Sand drains and prefabricated drains shorten drainage paths and accelerate excess-pressure dissipation without eliminating compressibility. The course connects grid geometry, equivalent diameter, radial time and installation smear to well resistance, loading, settlement and drain deterioration, establishing unloading and handover criteria from both pressure and movement. The source chronology records guide publication and evidence review rather than inventing a project construction history. 2017: FHWA lists the two-volume ground-modification reference manual in its improvement guidance; 2017: CEDD provides the 2017 updated Geoguide 2 as an investigation reference. Named comparisons illustrate functions and interfaces without attributing unverified methods. This course reconstructs public principles with original educational calculations, not the design documents of any project.
